title: Invoke-CronProcessor used for bounded item runs triggers full preflight and test path
description: Using Invoke-CronProcessor as a bounded processing entrypoint can unintentionally run broader maintenance, preflight, and test phases. For operator requests like process up to N items then stop, this is over-broad and slow.
detection_method: Regex scan for an actual Invoke-CronProcessor.ps1 INVOCATION (preceded by -File or &) without -BatchSize. Bare config/identifier/path string references (name=, path=, statusHints, source=) are not invocations and are intentionally not matched (FP reduction 2026-06-18).
preventionRule: For bounded queue processing requests, call Invoke-CronJob with explicit TaskId and BatchSize instead of the full processor orchestrator.
